description: End-to-end management of API gateway-backed data/ML pipelines, including creation, versioning, routing, deployment, traffic controls, and rollback.

gateway_id.description: Unique identifier of an API gateway instance or cluster.

pipeline_id.description: Identifier of a logical data/ML pipeline exposed via the gateway.

pipeline_version_id.description: Identifier of a specific version of a pipeline definition.

route_id.description: Identifier of an API route mapping to a pipeline or pipeline stage.

deployment_id.description: Identifier of a concrete deployment of a pipeline version through the gateway.

policy_id.description: Identifier of a gateway policy (auth, rate limit, transform, etc.).

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: create_gateway_pipeline
functions.description: Create a new logical pipeline and register it with the API gateway.

gateway_id.description: Gateway where the pipeline will be registered.

description.description: Detailed description of the pipeline purpose.

initial_metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata such as domain, cost center, compliance flags.

functions.returns: Newly created pipeline with pipeline_id and default version information.

functions.name: define_pipeline_version
functions.description: Create or update a specific version of a pipeline, including DAG, data contracts, and ML components.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline to which this version belongs.

base_version_id.description: Optional base version to clone from.

changelog.description: Description of changes compared to previous version.

graph.description: Directed acyclic graph describing pipeline stages and dependencies.

condition.description: Optional expression deciding if edge should be followed.

io_contract.description: Input/output schemas and constraints for gateway exposure.

functions.returns: Created or updated pipeline version with pipeline_version_id and validation results.

functions.name: configure_gateway_route
functions.description: Create or update an API gateway route that maps external HTTP/GRPC endpoints to a pipeline version.

route_id.description: If provided, update existing route; otherwise create new.

traffic.description: Traffic management configuration (for version splits, canary, etc.).

weights.description: Weighted distribution across versions for 'weighted' strategy.

default_pipeline_version_id.description: Version used when no rule matches (for header_based).

functions.returns: Configured route with route_id and effective routing rules.

functions.name: attach_gateway_policy
functions.description: Attach or update policies (rate limiting, quotas, caching, WAF) on gateway routes or pipelines.

target_id.description: ID of the target entity (route_id, pipeline_id, or gateway_id).

types.description: List of policy components to apply.

dry_run.description: If true, only validate policy without applying.

functions.returns: Policy attachment result including policy_id and any validation or conflict warnings.

functions.name: deploy_pipeline_version
functions.description: Deploy a pipeline version to a specific environment through the gateway.

runtime_overrides.description: Deployment-time overrides for resources and scaling.

functions.returns: Deployment record with deployment_id, initial status, and rollout plan.

functions.name: get_deployment_status
functions.description: Get current status, health, and traffic allocation details for a deployment.
functions.returns: Deployment status with phase, conditions, health checks, and optional details.

functions.name: update_route_traffic_split
functions.description: Adjust or gradually shift traffic between pipeline versions for an existing route.

weights.description: New weighted distribution when using 'weighted' strategy.

header_rules.description: Updated header-based routing rules when using 'header_based' strategy.

gradual_shift.description: Optional configuration to gradually shift traffic over time.

target_pipeline_version_id.description: Version to gradually increase traffic to (for weighted strategy).

functions.returns: Updated traffic configuration and any scheduled gradual shift plan.

functions.name: check_pipeline_route_readiness
functions.description: Run pre-production readiness checks for a pipeline version and its route configuration.

route_id.description: Optional route to validate; if omitted, all routes for this version are checked.

test_traffic_sample.description: Optional synthetic requests to replay against the pipeline.

functions.returns: Readiness report summarizing each check result with pass/fail status and remediation hints.

functions.name: list_gateway_pipelines
functions.description: List pipelines on a gateway with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

search.description: Free-text search across name and description.

functions.returns: Paginated list of pipelines with basic metadata and latest deployment info.

functions.name: get_pipeline_and_route_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed configuration for a pipeline, its versions, and associated routes.
functions.returns: Pipeline entity with nested versions, routes, deployments, and optional associated data.

functions.name: rollback_pipeline_deployment
functions.description: Rollback a pipeline deployment to a previous stable version and update gateway routing.

target_pipeline_version_id.description: Optional specific version to rollback to; if omitted, auto-selected last stable.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate and return affected entities.

functions.returns: Rollback plan and, if executed, new deployment and route state reflecting the rollback.

functions.name: retry_failed_pipeline_invocations
functions.description: Retry failed invocations for a pipeline version or deployment, with optional filters and limits.

deployment_id.description: If provided, limit retries to a specific deployment.

max_attempts_remaining.description: Only retry invocations where remaining attempts >= this value.

dry_run.description: If true, only report which invocations would be retried.

functions.returns: Retry job summary with counts of selected invocations and a retry_job_id for tracking.

functions.name: suspend_or_resume_gateway_route
functions.description: Temporarily suspend or resume traffic on a route, optionally with safeguards.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for draining existing connections.

functions.returns: Operation result with new route state and any pending drain/suspend operations.

functions.name: delete_or_archive_pipeline
functions.description: Safely delete or archive a pipeline, cleaning up gateway routes and deployments as configured.

force.description: If true, proceed even if active traffic exists (only allowed with extra authorization).

replacement_pipeline_id.description: Optional replacement pipeline for route migration when archiving.

functions.returns: Cleanup or archival report listing affected routes, deployments, and final pipeline state.

functions.name: api_pipeline_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import api pipeline entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: api_pipeline_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many api pipeline entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: api_pipeline_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many api pipeline entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: api_pipeline_bulk_export
functions.description: Export api pipeline entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: api_pipeline_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across api pipeline entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: api_pipeline_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for api pipeline events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: api_pipeline_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for api pipeline notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: api_pipeline_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more api pipeline entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: api_pipeline_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to api pipeline on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: api_pipeline_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a api pipeline operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: api_pipeline_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending api pipeline change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: api_pipeline_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending api pipeline approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: api_pipeline_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a api pipeline entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: api_pipeline_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a api pipeline entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: api_pipeline_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a api pipeline entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: api_pipeline_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a api pipeline entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: api_pipeline_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for api pipeline activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: api_pipeline_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a api pipeline view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: api_pipeline_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to api pipeline entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: api_pipeline_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given api pipeline payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: api_pipeline_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a api pipeline entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: api_pipeline_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a api pipeline entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
